name: 68801 · Grand Island, NE
findings: ZIP 68801 (Grand Island) has 97 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 68801 (Grand Island) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 68801 (Grand Island) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).
